answer_1.quote: We introduce FollowupQ: A novel multi-agent framework for follow-up question generation for patient message enhancement.
answer_1.outputs: A set of follow‑up questions generated for a patient message

answer_2.quote: We introduce a novel evaluation metric, Requested Information Match (RIM), and a second metric Message Reduction % (MR%) to quantify performance.

answer_3.quote: We employ a fine‑tuned ... LLM‑as‑Judge framework to do a pairwise comparison between predicted and ground‑truth question sets.
